encounter: E0192 TRAINER_TARA (Route108, Feather Badge, cap 48, Medium)
availability_audit: Route 108 is the sea route to the Abandoned Ship, reached by Surf after the Balance Badge; battle index window 48-60, floor 48. Every member is gated at 36 or below in pool-48.json: New Mauville entrance and interior via Wattson's Basement Key (30), Thwackey line (36), Haunter plus Linking Cord (30), Sneasel (14), Togepi Route 102 plus Shiny Stone (24). All precede the first Surf. No legendaries, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species.
plan: Tara is three Water bodies plus an Eviolite Arctibax, and the sharp part is Seadra: Focus Energy plus a Scope Lens is a guaranteed critical hit, and Sniper multiplies that crit to 2.25x. The dossier's crack is exactly right - remove Seadra before the Focus Energy pays, or Taunt the turn it wants to spend. Gengar carries the Taunt and is fast enough to land it first; Weavile and Rillaboom carry priority so a Seadra that does set up still cannot pick its turn safely. Magnezone's Electric is 2x on all three Waters and Tara owns no Ground, Fire or Fighting move to answer it. Iron Hands' Fighting is 2x on Arctibax and Togekiss's Fairy is 2x on its Dragon half, which is what gets through an Eviolite. One deliberate restriction: Milotic has Competitive, so nothing on my side uses Icy Wind or any other stat-lowering move on it - that would hand it a Special Attack boost.
